name: Turanoceratops
sum: Turanoceratops is a ceratopsian from the Turonian Bissekty Formation of Uzbekistan, transitional between early ceratopsians and ceratopsids.
wsnote: Estimate by Paul cited in the Wikipedia revision.
holotype: Fragmentary fossils collected from the 1920s onwards near Dzharakuduk, Navoi Viloyat; the type material is not detailed in the sources used.
material: Fragmentary remains; PBDB lists six occurrences.
biology: Skull bore a pair of long brow horns like those of ceratopsids.
author: Nessov et al. 1989
